name: SPAR (Nizhny Novgorod)
note: The SPAR supermarket chain in Nizhny Novgorod; HC Torpedo's general partner, printed across the lower front of the 2026-27 home jersey. The club's partner feed links myspar.ru. An archived footer of myspar.ru (2020, via the Wayback Machine) named the operator as ООО «СПАР Миддл Волга» (SPAR Middle Volga LLC), a SPAR franchisee; its owners are not sourced, so the ownership chain is open. SPAR is a brand of the Dutch SPAR International wholesale network, but the local operator's ownership was not traced to a document.
